response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software craftsman with a strong background in web and full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang), but he lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of hands-on C++ development on Windows required for this role. Furthermore, he does not possess the requisite domain expertise in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, or Fixed Income, making him unsuitable for this highly specialized position despite his impressive overall engineering background.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience with strong architectural and polyglot programming skills.
Solid practical knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, test-driven development (TDD), and DevOps practices.
Some exposure to the financial sector via wealth management and investment platforms (RIDE Capital).
concerns: Severely lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ experience, possessing only 7 months of professional C/C++ exposure from 2014-2015.
Missing required domain expertise in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, or Fixed Income.
No demonstrated experience with Windows-specific development or enterprise databases like SQL Server/Oracle.
